title: ghost ship: emergency stop of the pump bildge

pages.caption: MUSTER STATION — where everyone gathers when the alarm sounds.
MUSTER STATION stencil, cut from a sea chart.
EMERGENCY STOP OF THE PUMP BILDGE — cut-off for the pump that empties water from the bottom of the hull. "bilge" is misspelled.
the same label, sprayed faint.
the printed version, russian above english: АВАРИЙНЫЙ СТОП НАСОСА ПОДСЛАНЕВЫХ ВОД. the misspelling is in this too.
CO2 RELEASE STATION — where the fire-fighting gas is let into the engine room. sprayed red.
the CO2 stencil, cut from a sign-off sheet listing the crew.
ПРОБЫ ТОПЛИВА / FUEL TEST — where fuel samples are kept, so a bad delivery can be proven later.
FUEL TEST, the stencil.
ЩИТ БЕРЕГОВОГО ПИТАНИЯ 380 V — "shore power panel": where the ship plugs into the port's electricity. the stencil.
the shore power panel label sprayed dark red.
ТОПЛИВНЫЙ ТАНК 1T 2T — "fuel tank" 1 and 2, sprayed red.
АККУМУЛЯТОРНАЯ — "battery room". stencil cut from a fumigation manual.
the battery room label sprayed black. handwritten: "paint the door before stencilling!!!"
ПРОБЫ МАСЛА — "oil samples", sprayed.
the oil samples stencil, cut from a crew's effects declaration.
ВТ №5 / ВТ №6 — tank no. 5 and no. 6, sprayed gray.
SWL 5 t — "safe working load": the most a crane or hook may lift. the stencil.
the SWL stencil, cut from a bill of lading for a bulk cargo loaded at azov, russia.
СПУСК — "descent": the way down, with an arrow. sprayed black.
the descent stencil, cut from a sea chart of ærøskøbing, denmark.
